faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV) is conducting this recruitment drive for various contractual positions in Jashpur, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IGKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Young Professional, Field Assistant, and Data Entry Operator under Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Jashpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different posts in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IGKV Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode via Registered or Speed Post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Young Professional post must be between 21 and 35 years of age, with category-based relaxations available.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualification is required for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Data Entry Operator post need a Bachelor's degree in any discipline along with a one-year diploma certificate in Data Entry Operator or Programming.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary range for these positions?
faq.answer: The fixed monthly salary ranges from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 30,000/- depending upon the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website at www.igkv.ac.in.
